'''Sera Jossi''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Fanatic Wookiees, that's our problem.|Sera Jossi|<ref name="SWGTCG">{{SWGTCG|set=The Shadow Syndicate|scenario=Crazy Wookiees promotional scenario}}</ref>}}
After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Sera Jossi resided in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Kachirho/Legends|Kachirho]] where she had an office.<ref name="SWGTCG" /> Nevertheless, she did not get into town very often and got her food delivered by the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Rroow]].<ref name="SWG:PfS" />

[[File:Crazy_Wookiee_village_2.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Mad Wookiees in the abandoned village]]
During that time, Jossi and a friend, the Wookiee bio-engineer [[Cheyerooto]], were concerned about a strange new disease afflicting a number of Wookiees.<ref name="SWG:SJ" /> The illness was marked by deteriorating health, giving rise to a madness which compelled the anguished Wookiees to attack anyone who approached them. As these Wookiees began to become dangerous, the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] issued [[Bounty/Legends|bounties]], via bounty [[Officer/Legends|officer]] [[Stren Colo]], for the insane Wookiees. As Jossi considered some sacrifices might be necessary for the overall good, she encouraged a number of spacers to hunt crazy Wookiees and claim the Imperial bounties.<ref name="SWG:DtCW">{{SWGcite|exp=RotW|type=general|Destroy the Crazy Wookiees|Kashyyyk}}</ref> In the meantime, the woman intended to discover the cause of the disease that afflicted the Wookiees.<ref name="SWG:SJ" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> she tasked a spacer with killing the Wookiee named [[Wrhisch]] and collecting his liver. Since the latter was one of the first to come under the sickness and was dying from the decay it caused, [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] Cheyerooto thought that the liver could be used to identify the disease and develop a cure. Guided by Sera Jossi, the spacer explored an [[Abandoned Wookiee village|old abandoned village]] inhabited by the mad Wookiees, found the Wookiee Wrhisch, killed him and collected his liver. The adventurer later delivered Wrhisch's liver to Doctor Cheyerooto.<ref name="SWG:SJ" /> As expected, the organ from the afflicted Wookiee allowed the bio-engineer to start developing a treatment. Eventually, Dr. Cheyerooto requested the spacer to find [[rrwii]] roots to finalize the cure.<ref name="SWG:TRR">{{SWGcite|exp=RotW|type=general|The Rrwii Root|Kashyyyk}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Sera Jossi was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:PfS" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Sera Jossi was added to the game with the release of the expansion pack [[Star Wars Galaxies: Rage of the Wookiees|''Rage of the Wookiees'']] on [[May 5]], [[2005]].<ref name="SWG:PfS" />
